read_by: claude-opus-5, read off the pages' OWN STORED BITMAPS -- the single CCITTFaxDecode image each page of this report carries (4400x3400, 1-bit, ~400 dpi), pulled out with `stream.rawdata` wrapped in a single-strip TIFF header and decoded as GROUP 3 2-D, then turned 270 degrees upright and cropped panel by panel at FULL SCALE, about 30 rows a read. NO recognition was used.
proof: `CALENDAR 2011 WAGES`, PDF pages 98-101 of the FY2011 annual town report (4117-fy-2011-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 95-98. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on every page -- and these four are printed SIDEWAYS, so each was turned upright before reading. THE PRINTED COLUMNS, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4): surname, forename | department | `$` amount, printed TWICE across each page as a LEFT and a RIGHT panel. `fund_name` carries the forename and the department the page prints beside each surname; `fund_number` is the surname with a position number so that two people of one surname are two rows (the digits are ignored by the ordering check). THESE PAGES PRINT NO TOTAL ANYWHERE, so there is NO ARITHMETIC TO CLOSE and NOTHING HERE PROVES A DIGIT. Say that plainly: a misread digit survives every check below untouched. FOUR CHECKS ARE DECLARED OR COMPUTED INSTEAD, and every one tests SHAPE or AGREEMENT, never value. (1) CELLS PER ROW: every row carries exactly one figure. (2) ORDER: the surname never goes backwards through all 565 rows, read LEFT PANEL THEN RIGHT PANEL, page by page. The panel and page boundaries are themselves the demonstration -- BURSCH then BUSH, DIPERRI then DISCAFANI-MARRO, HEALY then HEBERT, LONDA then LONDA, MURPHY then MURRAY, ROBUCCIO then RODER, TOUSIGNANT then TRUAX. The town sorts a SPACE BEFORE A LETTER (`MC CARTHY` before `MCCARRON`, `O' LOUGHLIN` before `OAKMAN`, `ST JEAN` before `STATELER`, `QUINN` before `QUINN STEARNS`), which is the sort this check uses. (3) THE GRID: 75 rows a panel, two panels a page, on pages 98, 99 and 100 -- 150 names each, counted off the printed page -- and 75 + 40 on page 101 where the list ends at ZRATE, SEAN. 565 names in all. This count is NOT declared as `rows_per_page` because the verifier sorts page numbers as STRINGS, so a run spanning `98` to `101` picks `99` as its last page and would assert 150 against page 101's 115. The SAME string sort bites twice: the page-read directory is globbed with `sorted()`, so splitting this run across files named p98 to p101 would have the group read p100, p101, p98, p99, and the order check would then report the surname going backwards once at a seam the sort invented. All four pages are therefore in ONE file, as FY2021's seven are. The defect is in the checker, not in this reading; it is written up with its diff. (4) A SECOND INSTRUMENT, and it is the only check here with any power over a digit. `report-gross-wages.csv`, the generic recognition extract, holds 326 figures for these four pages against the 565 the pages print. Matched by name, 161 of its figures AGREE with this reading exactly and 86 DISAGREE -- and every one of the 86 is the recognition pairing a label with the figure of the row ABOVE it, in unbroken runs (it reads ELKINS, ERIN = $3,935.00, which is the amount printed beside ECONOMO, JON on the line above). A further 79 of its rows carry a figure under a label that is blank, a bare department word or a mangled name. OF ALL 326, ONLY FIVE carry a figure that appears NOWHERE in this reading: three are the printed page folios 96, 97 and 98 read as money, one is `617,985.12` where the page prints $17,985.12 for HASTINGS, LISA, and one is `15,620.65` where the page prints $15,620.69 for STEELE, JAMES. BOTH of those two cells were then re-read at 2x on a crop of the page and the page's digits are unambiguous; the recognition is wrong in both. So no name in the recognition extract is absent from this reading, and no figure in it survives as a disagreement about what the page says. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a count of employees, of posts or of full-time equivalents, and not a payroll total. It is what the town printed beside each name for calendar 2011, with no FTE, no funding source and no dates (rule 11). ONE ODDITY, TRANSCRIBED AS PRINTED: the department beside HERRICK, KATHRYN on page 99 is printed as `161` -- a number where every other row prints a department name. It was re-read at 2x and the page does print `161`. What it means is not established here.
